concepts.title: Powers with Negative Exponents
concepts.definition: As the exponent decreases by 1, the value becomes one-tenth of the previous value. Continuing the pattern, 10^-1 = 1/10, 10^-2 = 1/10^2. In general, for any non-zero integer a, a^-m = 1/a^m, where m is a positive integer. a^-m is the multiplicative inverse of a^m.
concepts.key_idea: Negative exponent means the reciprocal of the positive power.

concepts.title: Laws of Exponents for Integer Exponents
concepts.definition: For any non-zero integers a and b and any integers m and n: (i) a^m x a^n = a^(m+n); (ii) a^m / a^n = a^(m-n); (iii) (a^m)^n = a^(mn); (iv) a^m x b^m = (ab)^m; (v) (a/b)^m = a^m / b^m; (vi) a^0 = 1. These laws hold for negative exponents also.
concepts.formula: a^m x a^n = a^(m+n); a^m / a^n = a^(m-n); (a^m)^n = a^(m*n); a^0 = 1
concepts.key_idea: The exponent laws work for negative integers too.

concepts.title: Finding an Unknown Exponent
concepts.definition: When both sides of an equation have powers with the same base different from 1 and -1, their exponents must be equal. For example, find m so that (-3)^(m+1) x (-3)^5 = (-3)^7: adding exponents gives m + 6 = 7, therefore m = 1.
concepts.formula: if a^m = a^n (a not 1 or -1) then m = n

concepts.title: Small Numbers in Standard Form
concepts.definition: Very small numbers can be expressed in standard form using negative exponents. For example, 0.000007 = 7/1000000 = 7/10^6 = 7 x 10^-6, so the thickness of a hair 0.0016 cm = 1.6 x 10^-3 cm. In standard form a number is written as d.ddd x 10^n.
concepts.key_idea: Count the places the decimal moved right; that is the negative exponent.

concepts.title: Usual Form from Standard Form
concepts.definition: To express a number in usual form from standard form, multiply out the power of 10: 3.52 x 10^5 = 3.52 x 100000 = 352000; 7.54 x 10^-4 = 7.54/10^4 = 0.000754; 3 x 10^-5 = 3/100000 = 0.00003.
concepts.key_idea: Positive exponent shifts right; negative exponent shifts left.

concepts.title: Comparing and Combining Numbers in Standard Form
concepts.definition: To compare very large or very small numbers divide their standard forms. To add or subtract numbers in standard form, we convert them into numbers with the same exponents: 5.97 x 10^24 + 7.35 x 10^22 = 597 x 10^22 + 7.35 x 10^22 = 604.35 x 10^22.
